How it was found
- The p99 limit of 200 ms is a wall (SPEC.md: "not negotiable"). It was a hard filter on every candidate,
  never traded in a score. No setting above 200 ms was kept or reported as a result.
- Exhaustive search with bench.measure over batch_size 1..9, workers 1..39, prefetch 0..39 (n = 1174
  settings within the wall). This covers the whole feasible space: batch_size 9 alone gives p99 215.6 ms,
  and higher workers or prefetch are over the wall for every batch size.
- bench.py is deterministic (same config, same numbers), so one run per setting is enough.

Open

- No gate.py or gate.json exists in the work folder, so the gate here is bench.py plus the 200 ms wall.
